channel.title: Michael West Media – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Michael West Media – Bias and Credibility (michaelwest.com.au)

item.title: Grace Tame. A 'difficult' woman who scares men of power - Michael West
item.description: What happened to Grace Tame tells you what you need to know about who holds power in this country and how ruthlessly they will defend it.

item.title: Labor tosses up reform options as inflation storm looms - Michael West
item.description: Australia expects to be buffeted by economic headwinds blowing from the Middle East, putting economic reform at the forefront of budget discussions.

item.title: ABC shows off the air as staff walk out over pay offer - Michael West
item.description: A lacklustre pay deal with a below-inflation increase has triggered one of the largest strikes in the national broadcaster's history.

item.title: Prosecco makers popping corks as free trade deal struck - Michael West
item.description: Australian prosecco makers are among those cheering a landmark free trade deal with the European Union, but farmers have slammed it as inadequate.

item.title: Rothschild bank raid in Epstein-linked probe into envoy - Michael West
item.description: The Paris offices of a prestigious Swiss bank have been raided as France investigates alleged links to late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Aussie shares dip as Trump vows escalation before exit - Michael West
item.description: The Australian equities market has done an about face after President Donald Trump told Americans in a national address the US is going to finish Iran "fast".

item.title: PM announces long-awaited gambling ad crackdown - Michael West
item.description: Blackout periods and other restrictions to betting ads will be introduced in a bid to reduce Australian children's exposure to gambling harms.

item.title: ASX vows reform after placing 'investors over markets' - Michael West
item.description: A final report on exchange operator ASX has noted its defensive culture and favouring of shareholder returns over resilient technology platforms for investors.

item.title: Aussie dish serves up second helping for moon mission - Michael West
item.description: A space dish in Australia is tracking NASA's new moon mission in a sequel to the nation's key role in televising one of humanity's biggest achievements.

item.title: Australia faces 'sharp recession' if US escalates war - Michael West
item.description: As Donald Trump fails to reassure traders about the Strait of Hormuz, analysts warn Australia's economy is hurtling towards a recession the longer it is closed.

item.title: The Iran war and the price of Albanese's complicity - Michael West
item.description: Amid Trump's delusional speech and Albanese's denial of responsibility, the Iran war continues at the huge cost of lives and livelihoods.

item.title: US, Iran must be 'pulled back' from prolonged war - Michael West
item.description: Australia must work with partner nations to help convince the US and Iran to end the war, as any contribution from Canberra is unlikely to shift the dial.

item.title: Fuel fears put brakes on travel as supply hopes rise - Michael West
item.description: Fuel supplies around the nation are improving but Australians are still cutting back on travel over the Easter long weekend.

item.title: Easter holiday hunts closer to home as fuel prices bite - Michael West
item.description: The surging cost of living will curtail the Easter plans of many people, but plenty will still put family and indulgence above tightening the belt.

item.title: Mike Pezzullo. A gossiper who loved to peddle his influence - Michael West
item.description: MWM has obtained the Pezzullo inquiry report after a long FOI fight. It documents a litany of transgressions and allegations.
